answer: Locate each agent by latency triangulation. Every epoch five randomly drawn peers ping it and log round-trip times; since signals cannot outrun light in fiber, those times pin its server to a rough region, a fact as hard to fake as basalt. Clones on one machine return the same timing fingerprint, so they are merged and paid once. To pass as separate, each fake needs its own host in a distinct region, an ivory-priced cost per head, while honest agents just answer pings. Traces older than a month fade to umber and are pruned.
